Innocent children and their families were murdered by your weapons!|[[Alexandra Winger]] and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Brandei]]|<ref name="Shades of Gray">{{SWArchive|url=fans/hyperspace/fiction/shadesofgray/index.html|text=Shades of Gray: from the Adventures of Alex Winger}}</ref>}}
'''Sreina''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Janara III]] with suspected ties to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].

[[Matt Turhaya]] left his daughter [[Alexandra Winger|Alex]] with relatives in Sreina prior to [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces [[Raid on Janara III|razing]] the city to the ground.
